summary: OddOne Gaming evaluates all selectable legendary heroes in the Legendary Hero Prime Chest obtained from the 14-day Otherworld Tour event log-in. He ranks hero choices based on overall utility, team support roles, Arena viability, and inspiration priority. Synarell, Acilia, Phaessa, Rose, Feenja, and Felosia are highlighted as the top high-value support options, while heroes like Malak, Ergander, Dalk, Ghul'ende, and Zeffi are lower priority or situational picks.

heroes.name: Synarell
heroes.note: Functions as a top-tier solo support for most teams and is a high priority candidate for Inspiration 5.

heroes.name: Acilia
heroes.note: Provides debuff immunity, dispels, and massive healing, serving as an exceptional solo support.

heroes.name: Phaessa
heroes.verdict: Top tier support for PvP and PvE
heroes.note: Applies passive initial recharge and accuracy penalties, energy reduction, damage delay, and debuff immunity.

heroes.name: Rose
heroes.note: Offers strong healing, Attack Penalty II, debuff dispels, recharge speed penalties, and scales with Enlightenment.

heroes.name: Feenja
heroes.verdict: High tier healer and resist buffer
heroes.note: Provides heavy healing, dispels, Resistance Up II, and shares resistance with adjacent allies.

heroes.name: Felosia
heroes.verdict: Top tier shielder and mitigation support
heroes.note: Grants strong shields, Control Immunity, Damage Reduction, and Defense Up II.

heroes.name: Astalon
heroes.note: Provides healing, silence, defense steal, and energy reduction, though slightly nerfed on heal scaling.

heroes.name: Halramar
heroes.note: Passive reduces enemy ultimate energy gain by 80% at battle start.

heroes.name: Garrika
heroes.note: Gains ultimate energy when enemies gain buffs and reduces enemy ultimate energy.

heroes.name: Quaesitia
heroes.note: Inflicts recharge speed penalty, fear control, and ultimate energy reduction.

heroes.name: Theodemer
heroes.note: Rarely used as cheaper options like Garius can fulfill similar tanking duties.

heroes.name: Ghul'ende
heroes.note: Quirky kit with a high ultimate recharge cost.

heroes.name: Dalk
heroes.note: Generally low priority and rarely recommended over top supports.

heroes.name: Ergander
heroes.note: Low priority selection from the prime chest.

heroes.name: Malak
heroes.note: Generally not recommended unless needed for a very specific roster gap.

heroes.name: Zeffi
heroes.note: Has been largely powercrept in recent seasons and sees limited use.

teams.note: Used in Thunderbolt boss teams to land debuffs and slow enemy ultimate energy.

meta_changes: Acilia has largely powercrept Mithrasea as the premier dispel and debuff immunity support.
Zeffi and Felosia face increased competition from newer supports and shielder options like Solmeld.
tips: The Legendary Hero Prime Chest selection pool is fixed and does not change across seasons, so saved chests remain reserved indefinitely.
Prioritize Synarell for Inspiration level 5 to enable solo supporting across multiple teams.
Inspiration stages on Phaessa increase her battle skill target cap to 4 allies, significantly boosting her overall team mitigation and healing.
